Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: professional Indian wedding ceremony clipart for a premium mobile invitation website. A single original cohesive botanical gouache-and-watercolour illustration, refined thin umber outlines, softly modelled painterly texture, warm antique gold, natural sage/forest foliage, ivory jasmine, rich marigold orange and muted rose accents. High craft, realistic object construction, elegant proportions, detailed but clearly readable at 150px. Three-quarter frontal composition, isolated full subject centered with generous 12% transparent padding, landscape 4:3 visual arrangement on a square canvas. GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY, no opaque background, no gradient background, no rectangle, no cast shadow outside the objects. No lettering, words, numbers, labels, watermark, logo, people, deity or sacred religious symbol. Not a flat icon, not plastic 3D, not a photograph. Create only the requested still-life illustration.
